name: bizplug-saas
description: The saas & software plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: book a product demo. It works from the business's own published profile, covering features, pricing, integrations and demo requests, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
